metadata.description: continuum marketplace — project continuity across session boundaries for Claude Code

plugins.name: continuum
plugins.description: Checkpoints a distilled resume bundle before context compaction (PreCompact) and on demand, then auto-resumes a fresh low-token session with goal/progress/decisions/next-steps (SessionStart). Engram-optional with local fallback and offline resync. Project-local storage, secret redaction, untrusted-input boundary. Pairs with silex and engram.
